snippet.title: Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin Out Now! | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Forge a mighty realm from the ashes in Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin. Journey into the Withered Worlds and explore devastated landscapes. Contains a new culture, form, wildlife and magical tomes, as well as new environmental challenges and locations to conquer and explore.

Get Rise from Ruin as a part of Expansion Pass 3: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976440/Age_of_Wonders_4_Expansion_Pass_3/
